Cells 101

Cells are the basic structural and functional unit of all known living organisms.

Organelles

The mitochondria is the powerhouse of the cell, producing ATP through oxidative phosphorylation.

The nucleus houses the cell's genetic material and coordinates activities including growth, metabolism, and reproduction.

The cell membrane

The cell membrane is a selectively permeable barrier that controls what enters and leaves the cell.
